status: PREPARED (2026-11-03, revised after the maintainer's review of 77be6e13): code ready, the generation BOUNDED by the frozen plan (bounded_plan, plans/tool_generation_plan.json); nothing generated; a session needs its own authorization
_contract: The teacher-native tool-calling generation of the packed round: which teacher, which modes, which pool splits, the runner's execution terms. The task protocol (task_record, verification, supervision) is six_category_design.json :: task_pool / protocol, executed by tool_episodes.py and tool_admission.py. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.

pool.candidate_sources: CANDIDATES under the maintainer's review, none approved (logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/audit/tool_calling_source_review_v2.json): priority candidates Agent-Ark/Toucan-1.5M @0df3cf37 and the NeMo Gym Pivot pair @0ac34ec8/@bfc7a4dd, both still owing their admission review; nvidia/Nemotron-SFT-Agentic-v4 deferred until its licence, generator-output terms and upstream tool provenance are confirmed
pool.rules: tool_pool.py (schema tool_pool/v4): per-atom splits (MCP server or tool identity), eval-set-1 and public-benchmark decontamination (prompt keys, 13-gram containment, tool identities), T4 between splits, T5, replay conflicts refused, the 6,144-token first-prompt bound under every lineage and mode below; episode shapes (six_category_design.json :: protocol.episode_shapes) are tiers of every split's frozen order -- the full episodes first, then the single_step_gold_tool_call@v1 tasks (schema_arguments, Pivot Conversational) -- and a T5 duplicate keeps the full episode

execution._: request_seed(seed_base, task_id, turn), candidate pass k at seed_base + k, the same rule for every teacher, so a (task, candidate, turn) has one seed whatever the model; 2: pass 1 only for a task whose first candidate fails verification (the current protocol)

bounded_plan._contract: The bounded generation (maintainer review of 77be6e13, P0-1): what each lineage, mode and split generates, counted in its consumer's unit BEFORE packing, walked in the pool's frozen orders, stopped at the target, bounded. tool_generation_plan.py turns these terms into the plan the session runs (logs/stages/stage-2/teacher_modes/plans/tool_generation_plan.json).

training.by_category: six_category_common_support.json :: tool_calling.categories[*].share (the registered common-support composition, maintainer 2026-11-05; six_category_design.json's shares stay the registered identity's and split calibration and state evaluation)
training._: each arm's sixth base-corpus type: 1/6 of A1-6cat's / A2-6cat's 2,960,507 base-category supervised tokens; C1-6cat's registered 492,587

validation._: six_category_design.json :: validation (the hybrid's 32 validation-split tasks per mode; C1-6cat's historical 12,624 supervised tokens)

calibration._: the base profile's tool cell; the reasoning-heavy cell (1,800) is a prefix of the same frozen order (packed_inputs.profiles_v2)

state_eval._: state_eval_hybrid@v2's floor; every category the split holds with >= 5 tasks (THIN reported)

priors._: [low, expected, high]; six_category_design.json :: tool_calling.expected_per_arm (A1's teacher evaluation and Thinking-2507's historical tool turns). A pilot's measured values replace them before the cap is final

rounds.first: per cell the frozen-order prefix whose expected yield reaches the target
rounds.top_up: ceil(remaining units / observed units per attempted task x top_up_margin); with nothing admitted yet, the pessimistic prefix of what is left; the LAST round (max_rounds) takes every task left within the bound
rounds.bound: a cell never attempts more than the frozen-order prefix whose pessimistic yield (the lower end of its measured stratum, else the low tokens per turn and pass rate) reaches its target, nor more than its supply; a whole-supply cell (six_category_common_support.json :: whole_supply_cells) is bound by its whole remaining supply; a cell still short at its bound or after max_rounds is a SHORTFALL -- of its bound when supply remains (a top-up continues from the frozen order), of its source only when its whole supply was attempted
rounds.invocations: one engine invocation per mode and round for the first candidates, one for the second candidates of the round's refused tasks
rounds._first_round_bound_lineages: a lineage whose remaining cumulative budget holds about ONE round takes its cells' bound in round 1 instead of the expected prefix (maintainer 2026-11-05, review of f06ccd4, section 3: Thinking-2507's top-up inside the real remainder of its $2.78, $1.5371 = about 22 driver minutes at $1.09/h; one round with its tail, rarely two). The bound is the prefix whose measured LOWER yield reaches the target, which the upper price already pays for; every task is a new one in the frozen order, and admitted episodes beyond a target stay unused (six_category_common_support.json :: freeze)

throughput._: decode: the supplement's measured batched throughput on one L40S (SIX_CATEGORY.md); the tool-workload efficiency, prefill rate and model load are UNMEASURED ranges [slow, expected, fast] until the pilot; prompt_tokens_default only where a task has no first_prompt_tokens

bounded_plan._approved_shortfalls: the maintainer's approvals of a cell's SHORTFALL, each {split, mode, category, approved_by}; empty: no category may fall short. The plan carries them (tool_generation_plan.verified checks the copy); packed_inputs counts an unapproved short or thin category as unmet, so calibration v2 and state_eval_hybrid@v2 stay SHORT and nothing is frozen
